reason: Machine lens: all opcodes (TXA, STA abs, JSR, RTS, EQUB pad) are plain 6502, valid on the 65SC12. Old path STX abs (4) + LDA # (2) = 6 cycles; new TXA = 2: saves 4 a call, no indexed or branch instructions in the routine so no page-crossing terms. Bytes: STX abs 3 + LDA # 2 = 5 replaced by TXA 1 + 4 pad bytes after the RTS = 5, so compiled_call stays at &2FEE and everything from &2FF9 on (sky_main / kindcache_build) keeps its address; no later branch or table read moves. Self-modified operands: compiled_vec moves from &2FF7 to &2FF4 but every writer (render.6502 STA/STY compiled_vec, +1) and the JMP (compiled_vec) in compiled_direct are symbolic (65C02 JMP (abs) has no page bug, and &2FF4/5 is not a page edge anyway); compiled_back's only reference was its own STX (no other use in src/, tools/, grind_config). X preserved across the JSR: the generated banks 5-7 use only ADC#/AND#/BCC/BCS/BNE/CLC/CMP#/EOR#/JMP(compiled_unsafe_N)/LDA/LDA(zp),Y/LDY#/RTS/SBC#/SEC/STA/STA(zp),Y - no X instruction, no ,X mode, no JSR; HAZEL kinds are not called through compiled_call; irq1_handler starts PHX/PHY and the MOS preserves X. Flags at the RTS: old LDA #<X> and new TXA set N,Z from the same value, C/V untouched by both, so identical. Not refuted.
